# Editing the profile

Everything in `assets/` is generated by `render.py`. Don't edit the SVGs by hand; the next run overwrites them.

## Common changes

| To change | Edit |
| --- | --- |
| The sentence under the header, or the order of things | `README.md` |
| A card's title, description, version, link icon or colour | `CARDS` in `render.py` |
| A card's link target | the `<a href>` around it in `README.md` |
| The header text | `header()` in `render.py` |
| Chart and panel colours | `THEMES` in `render.py` |

You can do all of this in GitHub's web editor. Committing a change to anything in `.github/profile/` runs the workflow, which re-renders the panels and commits them a minute later.

## Adding a card

1. Add a row to `CARDS`. Width is `1200` for a full-width card or `600` for a half. Half cards go in pairs.
2. Give it a picture in `ART` (or reuse an icon from `icons/`; [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icons drop straight in).
3. Add it to `README.md`. Half cards sit on one line with nothing between them, each at `width="50%"`.

## Stats

The workflow runs daily at 06:17 UTC and on demand from **Actions → Profile stats → Run workflow**. It reads your contributions and repo languages with the `STATS_TOKEN` secret. When that token expires, the stats stop updating (they keep their last values); make a new token and replace the secret.

## Running it locally

```sh
pip install fonttools
# fonts: see the "Fetch IBM Plex" step in .github/workflows/profile.yml
GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) python .github/profile/render.py   # or --static for just header and cards
```
